How points work

1 point per damage dealt (up to 100 per opponent each round). 50 per knockout. 200 and 1 Win for last player standing. 25 for finishing a round.

Misses, blocked hits and practice earn nothing. Leaving alive forfeits the finish bonus. A timeout gives no Win unless only one player remains. Ties on points use Wins, then knockouts; exact ties share a rank.
